description: This file defines the internal class 'AzureTableStorageRemindersProviderBuilder' which implements 'IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>'. It configures an Azure Table Storage reminders provider in an Orleans silo, setting up service options like table name and connection based on the configuration section. The class is marked as internal and sealed, indicating it is used internally within the assembly to build or configure reminder storage providers.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageRemindersProviderBuilder
classes.description: Internal sealed class implementing IProviderBuilder for ISiloBuilder, responsible for configuring Azure Table storage reminder provider in Orleans.
